title: The Tao of OMIS

sourceEvidence.locator: On tidally locked Iria, Mara and Sio meet
sourceEvidence.excerpt: On tidally locked Iria, Mara and Sio meet in Vesper, a city stretched through the habitable dusk between permanent day and night. Their relationship develops amid floods, hospice work, memory research, migration, and flexible infrastructure. Neither is an idealized sage: both bring desire, ambition, interpretive habits, and capacities for influence that kindness cannot erase. The Way of the Open Knot offers practices rather than guarantees: name what one wants separately from what the other must

hook: Can you promise to love someone without claiming the person they may become?
readerPromise: This philosophical science fiction carries intimate questions into an immense imagined universe. Begin with the finite lovers, whose uncertain promises give the larger wonders something real to risk.
